Account Management: Own account: update profile, change password, profile picture (read/upload).
AppServices: App services (the connector services behind dataflows) — list, read, create, delete.
Audit Trails: Audit trail records — paged, filtered (`/AuditTrails/ByAll`, the Audit Trails screen).
Audit Utilities: Current user's audit records and Excel export.
Authentication: Token login (`/api/identity/token`), verify / resend the 2FA code, refresh. Don't script these; use the token file (see SKILL.md).
Authorization: OAuth authorization endpoint (consent / code), used by the Burq MCP connector.
AzureAd: Azure AD token for the tenant (returns a credential; don't call).
Batch History: Message counts per dataflow by status for a time window.
Cache: Cache status; clear all or one key (DELETE, writes).
Connection Management: Connections (credentials + endpoints per app) — list, by app, read, create, update, delete, test.
Connector Configuration: Tenant connector settings (GET + PUT): email quota, batch summary email, dataflow resync.
ConnectorScaling: Connector pod deployments: names, status, test, scale (scale is a write).
CrossRefs: Cross references (source id ↔ destination id per type, e.g. YHS_FIELD) and their rules — list, types, export, add/update/delete.
Data Packet Management: Data packets (the Transactions grid): Elasticsearch search (`dataPackets`, filter by `Id`, `ServiceIds`, `Status`, `SearchString`), children by parent, counts over time / by status, daily error groups and report; PUT status / data (writes). No GET by id.
Database Health: Message counts grouped by status and dataflow (monitoring).
Dataflow Management: Dataflows: list, options, manage, read, configurations, transformations, orchestration, system jobs; start/stop, cron, copy, import/export (writes).
DebugLogs: Debug logs (Info/Debug/Error) — all, filtered, count since a time (Debug Logs screens).
DynamicMapping: JSON mapping editor: read maps and metadata; `SaveJson` (a GET that writes) and `SaveJsonAtaQuery`.
Email Configurations: Email delivery profiles — list, create, update, delete, activate.
Meta Information: App meta: version, build, system info.
OAuthSession: Pending OAuth request details for the consent screen (MCP connector).
Packet Logs: Packet logs (Packet Logs screens) by correlation id, message id, id, or filtered/paged.
ProtectedResourceMetadata: OAuth protected-resource metadata for the MCP endpoint.
Testing: Ping (no auth), server info, Swagger redirect.
User Management: Users — list, search, filter, read, roles, export, CRUD, confirm email.
User Preferences: Save the current user's UI preferences.
Webhook Management: Generate an inbound webhook URL per dataflow (a GET that writes) and receive webhook posts.
Workspace Management: Workspaces: list, options, manage, read, CRUD, import/export, cloud copies.
